content.value_statement: React Flow nodes can break when handles, edges, resizing, and scroll behavior drift apart. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused checklist for stable workflow node changes.
actual_capabilities: Guides inspection of React Flow node components, shared helpers, and flow model data.
Explains how to keep sourceHandle and targetHandle ids aligned with rendered handles.
Recommends patterns for NodeResizer placement, controlled sizing, and clickable resize handles.
Covers drag handles, nodrag controls, nowheel scroll areas, and horizontal table scrolling.
Provides Markdown rendering guidance with react-markdown, remark-gfm, and skipHtml.
Defines verification checks for handles, edges, resizing, dragging, and scroll behavior.
limitations: Does not implement React Flow features without access to the project codebase.
Does not replace browser testing for visual layout and interaction behavior.
Does not provide current Vercel AI SDK API details without checking official documentation.
Focuses on React Flow workflow nodes, not general graph algorithms or backend workflow engines.

use_cases.title: Fix Missing Handle Errors
use_cases.description: Align rendered handle ids with edge sourceHandle and targetHandle values to resolve React Flow connection errors.
use_cases.target_user: Frontend engineers maintaining React Flow canvases

use_cases.title: Stabilize Resizable Nodes
use_cases.description: Place NodeResizer controls correctly and store node dimensions so resized nodes behave consistently after reloads.
use_cases.target_user: Product engineers building custom workflow nodes

use_cases.title: Improve Node Content Interaction
use_cases.description: Configure drag handles, clickable controls, and scroll containers so node content works without disrupting canvas movement.
use_cases.target_user: UI developers refining workflow editor interactions

prompt_templates.title: Check A Node Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single custom node.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-node-setup to review this React Flow node. Check handles, edge ids, sizing, drag behavior, and scroll areas before suggesting changes.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Edge Connections
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging for missing or incorrect handles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-node-setup to diagnose why these React Flow edges do not attach correctly. Compare every edge handle id with the rendered handles.

prompt_templates.title: Add Resizing Safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced node behavior change with layout risk.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-node-setup to add NodeResizer support to this custom node. Keep resize handles clickable and preserve controlled width and height.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Workflow Canvas Interactions
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across node, model, and canvas boundaries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-node-setup to audit this workflow editor change. Separate node layout, flow model wiring, canvas behavior, Markdown rendering, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: A node shows React Flow error 008 after adding a second output channel.
output: The rendered handle ids and edge source handles should be compared first.
Each output channel needs a stable, distinct handle id.
The flow model should reference those exact ids for affected edges.

output_examples.input: A resizable node clips the resize handles after a rounded container change.
output: Move the resizer outside clipped content or make it a direct child of the root node.
Keep the visual shell responsible for rounded overflow only.
Verify the resize handles remain clickable in the browser.

output_examples.input: A Markdown table inside a node pans the canvas instead of scrolling horizontally.
output: Keep the table scroller local to the table area.
Use nowheel behavior for internal scroll containers where needed.
Test vertical and horizontal scrolling without moving the canvas.

best_practices: Inspect node components, shared helpers, and flow model data before editing.
Keep handle ids stable once edges point to them.
Verify React Flow behavior in a browser after layout or wiring changes.
anti_patterns: Do not hand-roll handle styling when a shared workflow handle component exists.
Do not place NodeResizer controls under clipped containers that block interaction.
Do not render backend-provided HTML inside workflow nodes.

faq.question: What does this skill help configure?
faq.answer: It helps configure React Flow custom nodes, handles, edges, resizing, drag behavior, scroll areas, and Markdown output rendering.

faq.question: Can it fix React Flow error 008?
faq.answer: It can guide diagnosis by checking whether edge handle ids match rendered handle ids.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation guidance and recommends checks, but it does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The generated metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it cover Vercel AI SDK streaming?
faq.answer: It gives preparation guidance and tells users to verify current official documentation before integration.

faq.question: What testing does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends relevant lint, type, build, and browser checks based on the scope of React Flow changes.
